purpose: Identify the public SeagrassNet biological-download request interface and contributor schema without submitting a biological-data request.

allowed_access.same_origin_javascript_gets: script src resources referenced by the frozen download page only

required_interface_evidence: HTTP method or JavaScript request construction
required_schema_evidence: template fields/rows sufficient to understand species-by-transect quadrat layout
date/event identity field semantics discoverable from template or interface documentation before outcome access
stop_rule: If the biological download request cannot be frozen unambiguously from public interface code, stop before data access.
